### New in 1.5.8
- **Free-Floating To-Do Sticky Notes**: Notes on the To-do screen can now be moved and dragged anywhere on the screen! Place them above any to-do block or in empty space with smooth touch gestures and persistent coordinates.
- **Shelf Sticky Notes Editing & Tearing Separation**: Sticky notes on shelves can now be edited exclusively in the **Library** screen. On the **Home** screen, notes can be torn off or deleted anytime, keeping Home clean while preserving full editing capability in the Library.
- **Buy Me a Coffee**: Direct link to your personal Buy Me a Coffee page in Settings (`https://buymeacoffee.com/rrajkumarpadmanabhan`).

### Install / update
Download `shelfwise.apk` below and open it. It installs over older versions and keeps all your data.
